description: Read the variables in scope at a paused call frame, with objects and arrays expanded rather than printed as 'Object'. Includes `this`. Anything omitted for size is explicitly marked, so you never have to guess whether you saw the whole value.

depth.description: How many levels of nested objects to expand. 3 covers object → array → record.

frame_index.description: 0 is the innermost frame; see debugger_get_state for the stack.

include_global.description: Include the global scope (thousands of properties).

name: debugger_get_scope
